correctness.rationale: For odd m>=3 and n>=2, centered m-gonal triple a,b,c has differences mn,m(n+1),m(2n+1), and gcd(a,c)=gcd(2n+1,3m+8); only adjacent gcd-two pairs occur at n=2 mod4 and n=1 mod4. All three generators are minimal in the claimed range. The standard three-generator symmetry/gluing criterion reduces symmetry to one noncoprime pair with the remaining generator in the quotient-pair semigroup. For nonadjacent (a,c), splitting gcd d with s=(2n+1)/d shows s>1 impossible by coefficient/size inequalities and divisibility; s=1 gives explicit b=(n+1)a/t+n c/t. The adjacent pairs are excluded except at n=2, m=3,5,7, while m=9,n=2 already satisfies t|K. The gluing Frobenius law is ac/t-a-c+(t-1)b, with the exceptional formula (3m²+8m-1)/2; symmetry gives g=(F+1)/2. Divisor counting counts all t>1 dividing K=3m+8 and adds exceptions. Independently recomputed Apéry shortest-path F and genus for 238 odd-m pairs (3<=m<=35 odd, 2<=n<=15), all agreeing with the exact classification. The source script also includes a wider 198,602-case gluing check and 624 Apéry checks; its claimed output alone was not used as proof.
